Private books(1 To 3) As Workbook

Private Function Label() As String
    Dim i As Long
    Label = "other"
    For i = 1 To 3
        If ActiveWorkbook Is books(i) Then Label = Chr(96 + i)
    Next
End Function

Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    For i = 1 To 3: Set books(i) = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet): Next
    s = Label()
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        ActiveWindow.ActivateNext: s = s & "," & Label()
    Case 1
        ActiveWindow.ActivatePrevious: s = s & "," & Label()
    Case 2
        ActiveWindow.ActivateNext: s = s & "," & Label(): ActiveWindow.ActivateNext: s = s & "," & Label(): ActiveWindow.ActivateNext: s = s & "," & Label()
    Case 3
        ActiveWindow.ActivatePrevious: s = s & "," & Label(): ActiveWindow.ActivatePrevious: s = s & "," & Label(): ActiveWindow.ActivatePrevious: s = s & "," & Label()
    Case 4
        ActiveWindow.ActivateNext: s = s & "," & Label(): ActiveWindow.ActivatePrevious: s = s & "," & Label()
    Case 5
        books(1).Activate: s = s & "," & Label(): ActiveWindow.ActivateNext: s = s & "," & Label(): ActiveWindow.ActivatePrevious: s = s & "," & Label()
    Case 6
        books(1).Windows(1).ActivateNext: s = s & "," & Label()
    Case 7
        s = s & "," & TypeName(ActiveWindow.ActivateNext): s = s & "," & Label()
    End Select
    Tried = "ok " & s
Done:
    For i = 1 To 3: books(i).Close False: Next
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & s
    Resume Done
End Function

Public Function Probe() As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    s = "windows=" & (Windows.Count + 3)
    For i = 0 To 7
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i)
    Next
    Probe = s
End Function
